description: Tier 1 trigger evals — does the right skill fire for a given prompt? Weighted toward the description-collision risk EVALS.md calls out: deep-discovery vs technical-discovery vs pain-finder vs meddicc can all sound like 'audit this call'. Run via skill-creator's scripts/run_eval.py.

cases.prompt: Review this early-stage discovery call and tell me what the rep missed on pain and decision process.
This call was mostly about stack fit and integration scope — did the rep get the technical stakeholders right?
What are the top pain points this prospect raised, ranked by confidence?
Check this call against MEDDICC and tell me what's missing before the forecast call.
Quick BANT check on this first call before we invest more time.
Did this qualification call actually establish a real deal, or is this rep chasing a ghost?
Grade this demo — did the rep tailor it or just run the standard script?
Is this pilot on track to convert, or stalling?
Late-stage negotiation call — where does pricing and procurement actually stand?
Did this call end with an actual dated next step, or just 'we'll circle back'?
New rep's first few calls — how's their foundational technique, opening and pain uncovering?
How's this new customer's onboarding going based on the kickoff call?
Run a QBR depth check on this account health-review call.
Is this account at risk of churning based on the renewal check-in call?
Is this account ready for an upsell conversation, or should we check health first?
Sweep this pipeline export for deals missing discovery fields.
